Home → Ready-made lessons → Kan man verkligen förändra sin personlighet?
B2–C1Psychology and people

Kan man verkligen förändra sin personlighet?

Can you change your personality – and how far? You learn to use sin / sitt / sina and hans / hennes / deras correctly (the Ukrainian “свій”, meaning “one’s own”, helps here) and create a life timeline for an imaginary person who changed their behaviour.

Level
B2–C1
Topic
Psychology and people
Duration
≈ 60 min

Ask about this lesson

Payment and access via Patreon.

About the lesson

What happens in the lesson

You tell a person’s character traits from their behaviour, read the text “Från larv till fjäril?” about how far a person can change, and put your own view into words in a text called “Min syn på förändring”.

Suitable for students at level B2–C1 who study on their own, and for teachers who need a ready-made lesson of ≈ 60 minutes. The slides with answers help both with self-checking and during the lesson.

What you’ll learn

Language you can use straight away

📚

Key phrases

Phrases from the lesson text that you practise in the exercises.

  • sätter sina spår
  • gå emot sin natur
  • lära sig av erfarenhet
  • växa som människa
  • komma till insikt om
🧩

Grammar

The reflexive possessive sin / sitt / sina versus hans / hennes / deras – the Ukrainian “свій” (one’s own) helps here.

💬

Practice

In a group you invent a person and draw a timeline of their life with four or five moments when they changed their behaviour or character.

Lesson plan

Step by step

  1. Warm-upVad tänker du?5 min
  2. SortingÄr eller gör?8 min
  3. ReadingFrån larv till fjäril?8 min
  4. True or falseSant, falskt eller inte riktigt?7 min
  5. VocabularyVad betyder det?optional · 6 min
  6. Fill in the gapsFyll i luckorna5 min
  7. GrammarSin eller hans?6 min
  8. Choose the right formVems är det?6 min
  9. Word orderBygg förändringen5 min
  10. ProjectEtt liv på en tidslinje10 min
  11. DiscussionHur är det hos dig?optional · 6 min

Total ≈ 60 min (not counting optional tasks)
